# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_mobile_api_protection

Configures mobile API protection for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/mobile_api_protection`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_mobile_api_protection` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_mobile_api_protection" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status       = true
    action       = "alert_deny"
    token_header = "Jwt_Token"
    # Sensitive: the JWT signing secret. Reference a variable or secret store
    # rather than inlining the literal secret value.
    token_secret = var.mobile_api_token_secret

    url_list {
      item {
        url = "/login"
      }
    }
  }
}

variable "mobile_api_token_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- `token_secret` is sensitive but remains part of Terraform state. Protect state storage and supply the value through a sensitive variable.

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed mobile API protection configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_mobile_api_protection` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_mobile_api_protection.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
